caption: A slow-motion close-up shows a metallic hammer head above gray gravel, already amid a dense white dust cloud. Brown fragments with pale yellow interiors hang in the air to the right, drifting slowly. The hammer lifts upward through the haze, revealing more of its neck as its lower edge rises away from the ground. A large brown chunk rotates and drifts toward the upper right, exiting the frame while smaller yellow flecks scatter and settle. Near the center, a curved brown fragment rests on the gravel, staying in place while the surrounding powder continues to move. The dust cloud gradually thins, disperses, and settles onto the coarse surface. The background and frame edges remain fixed, keeping the motion centered on the rebounding tool and airborne debris.
relations: Hammer head above dust lifts upward, revealing neck while its lower edge rises away from gravel.
Large brown chunk rotates toward upper right and exits frame while smaller yellow flecks settle.
Curved brown fragment on gravel remains placed while surrounding powder continues moving and settling.
Dust cloud gradually thins and settles onto coarse surface, keeping background and frame edges fixed.
